identity.name: Clearmind Therapy
identity.tagline: Space to breathe. Room to grow.
identity.one_line_description: Clearmind Therapy is a modern mental health practice connecting individuals, couples, and families with compassionate, evidence-based therapists in a calm, structured environment.
identity.target_audience: Adults aged 22–55 seeking individual, couples, or family therapy for anxiety, depression, life transitions, or relationship challenges — including first-time therapy seekers who need a trustworthy, low-pressure entry point.

items.title: Individual Therapy
items.description: One-on-one sessions focused on your personal goals — managing anxiety, depression, trauma, grief, self-esteem, or life transitions.

items.title: Couples Counseling
items.description: Guided sessions to improve communication, rebuild trust, and navigate conflict — whether you're in crisis or simply want to grow closer.

items.title: Family Therapy

sections.intent: Help visitors who are unsure whether in-person or telehealth is right for them make a confident, informed decision.
sections.headline: Both paths lead to real progress.
sections.subheadline: Here's how to decide what works best for you.

items.title: In-Person Therapy
items.description: Best for clients who value face-to-face connection, a dedicated physical space to decompress, and minimal screen time during sessions.

items.title: Telehealth Therapy
items.description: Best for clients with busy schedules, mobility limitations, or who simply feel more comfortable opening up from their own space.

sections.intent: Remove common barriers to booking by answering the practical and emotional questions that hold first-time clients back.
sections.headline: Answers before you even have to ask.

items.title: Do you accept insurance?
items.description: We accept most major insurance plans including Aetna, BlueCross BlueShield, Cigna, and United Healthcare. We also offer a sliding scale for self-pay clients.

items.title: How do I know which service is right for me?
items.description: Our free 15-minute consultation call is designed exactly for this. A care coordinator will listen and help match you with the right therapist and format.

items.title: What if I don't connect with my therapist?
items.description: Therapeutic fit matters deeply to us. If the match isn't right, we'll help you transition to another practitioner at no additional cost.

items.title: How long does therapy typically last?
items.description: It varies by person and goal. Some clients see meaningful progress in 8–12 sessions; others choose ongoing support. Your therapist will regularly check in on your progress.

items.title: Is everything I share confidential?
items.description: Yes. All sessions are fully confidential under HIPAA, with narrow legal exceptions your therapist will explain during your intake session.

sections.intent: Tell the origin story of the practice — why it was founded and what values drive it — to build institutional trust and differentiate Clearmind from generic therapy directories.
sections.headline: Therapy is a relationship, not a transaction.
sections.body: Clearmind Therapy was founded on a simple belief: that the quality of the relationship between therapist and client is the single most powerful predictor of healing. We don't rush intake. We don't overload caseloads. We hire practitioners who believe in their work and take the time to know each person they sit with. Every therapist on our team has been chosen not only for their credentials, but for their capacity to be genuinely present. That's the Clearmind difference.

sections.headline: Start here.
sections.subheadline: Our most-read guides, written by our clinical team.

items.title: What to Expect in Your First Therapy Session
items.description: First sessions can feel daunting. Here's a step-by-step look at what actually happens — and how to make the most of it.

items.title: CBT vs. DBT: Which Approach Is Right for You?
items.description: Two of the most widely used therapy modalities explained side by side, with guidance on when each is most effective.

items.title: Understanding Anxiety: More Than Just Worry
items.description: A clinical but accessible breakdown of generalized anxiety disorder — its symptoms, causes, and most effective treatments.

items.title: How to Talk to Your Partner About Starting Couples Therapy
items.description: Practical, compassionate language for bringing up couples counseling without it feeling like an accusation.

items.title: Burnout Is Not Laziness: A Guide for High Achievers
items.description: Why high-functioning professionals are among the most at-risk for burnout — and what recovery actually looks like.

items.title: Supporting a Teen Through Depression: A Parent's Guide
items.description: Practical, evidence-informed advice for parents navigating a teenager's mental health — including when to seek professional help.

sections.intent: Contextualize the resource library with a brief editorial statement from the clinical team, reinforcing the practice's commitment to education and destigmatization.
sections.headline: We believe informed clients heal faster.
sections.body: Every article, guide, and tool in our resource library was created or reviewed by a licensed Clearmind practitioner. We don't publish generic wellness content. We write about what we see in session — the real questions people ask, the real barriers they face, and the real strategies that work. Mental health literacy is part of the healing process, and we're committed to making it accessible to everyone, whether or not they're our clients.

sections.intent: Convert resource readers into therapy clients by offering a natural next step — moving from education to action.

sections.subheadline: Book a free 15-minute consultation and take what you've learned into your first session.

sections.intent: Address the final practical questions that arise at the contact stage — insurance, cancellation, and what to expect after submitting the form — to remove last-mile hesitation.
sections.headline: A few things people usually ask us.

items.title: How quickly will I hear back?
items.description: We respond to all consultation requests within one business day. Most clients hear back the same afternoon.

items.title: Is the consultation really free?
items.description: Yes — always. The 15-minute call is designed to help us understand your needs and answer your questions, with no obligation to book.

items.title: What if I'm not sure I'm ready for therapy?
items.description: That's exactly what the consultation is for. Many of our clients use it just to ask questions and get a feel for the process before committing.

items.title: Do you have a cancellation policy?
items.description: We ask for 24 hours' notice for cancellations or rescheduling. Late cancellations may incur a fee, which your therapist will explain at intake.

items.title: Can I request a specific therapist?
items.description: Absolutely. If you've reviewed our practitioners page and have a preference, let us know in your message and we'll do our best to accommodate.
